segments.name: Life sciences technology
segments.description: Provides instruments, consumables and software that let academic, translational and biopharmaceutical researchers analyze single cells and tissue spatially at high resolution and scale.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Academic, government, biopharmaceutical and biotechnology researchers pay for instruments, consumables and software, purchased through our direct sales force or third-party distributors.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers primarily include academic, government, biopharmaceutical, biotechnology and other institutions focused on life sciences research.
